rule: Core evaluation ends after 36 calendar months
derivation_rationale: A bounded horizon permits a mandatory decision without waiting for a favorable regime; it is not calibrated to any realized result.

rule: One extension is permitted only after INCONCLUSIVE
derivation_rationale: A single fixed addition can improve information while preventing repeated optional stopping.

rule: No evaluation may extend beyond the original start plus one extension
derivation_rationale: The 36-month core plus one 12-month extension is a finite predeclared maximum.

rule: Minimum paired daily sessions for directional primary evidence
derivation_rationale: A minimum information count is required for a HAC estimate; it does not require a number of favorable trades or crossings.

rule: Cap for the predeclared Newey-West lag rule
derivation_rationale: The cap limits unstable long lags while the formula scales with the observed sample size.

rule: Two-sided confidence interval level
derivation_rationale: A conventional uncertainty display is fixed before observations and is not selected for a desired result.

rule: One-sided alpha when adequacy is met
derivation_rationale: The directional error rate is declared before the primary weekly series exists; no p-value is calculated now.

rule: Annualized HAC interval materially below this floor is economic FAIL
derivation_rationale: A two-percentage-point negative floor distinguishes harmful degradation from uncertainty around zero; it is a conservative design limit, not a historical quantile.

rule: p95 absolute OBSERVED_SLIPPAGE_PROXY_BPS must not exceed when market-data proxies are observable
derivation_rationale: The nearest-rank p95 is computed from eligible order-level bid/ask or opening-auction proxies; it is not realized broker slippage and is NOT_OBSERVABLE_IN_PAPER_MODE when fewer than 20 valid proxies exist.

rule: p95 absolute CANONICAL_FILL_TRACKING_DIFFERENCE_BPS must not exceed when market-data proxies are observable
derivation_rationale: This compares the canonical simulated fill with a same-timestamp market-data proxy and remains separate from dollar NAV reconciliation.

rule: signal_to_order_latency_seconds must not exceed this PAPER_SYSTEM_OPERATIONAL_DIAGNOSTIC limit
derivation_rationale: Defined as order_created_at minus signal_close_at; it is a paper-system timing diagnostic, not live-execution evidence.

rule: simulated fill recording latency must not exceed this PAPER_SYSTEM_OPERATIONAL_DIAGNOSTIC limit
derivation_rationale: Defined from fill_recorded_at minus intended_execution_at; it is not an achievable live order-to-fill claim.

rule: A scheduled close acquired later than this is stale and incident-only
derivation_rationale: A fixed freshness boundary makes stale-data handling deterministic and fail-closed.

rule: PAPER_SEVERE_RISK_GOVERNANCE_LIMIT: strategy MaxDD below this level is a hard paper risk failure
derivation_rationale: A conservative severe-loss governance limit protects paper-risk oversight; it is not an ORIGINAL_RESEARCH_OBJECTIVE and does not claim historical dominance.

rule: PAPER_SEVERE_RISK_GOVERNANCE_LIMIT: strategy drawdown difference versus QQQ below this level is a hard paper risk failure
derivation_rationale: Ten percentage points is a predeclared governance limit; Goal A/B/C remain separate ORIGINAL_RESEARCH_OBJECTIVE outputs.

rule: Annual turnover using contemporaneous pretrade equity must not exceed
derivation_rationale: Six times capital is a prospective implementation-burden ceiling and is not calibrated to an observed outcome.

rule: Absolute NAV reconciliation difference must be at most
derivation_rationale: One cent is a serialization and rounding tolerance for ledger reconciliation, not an economic allowance.

rule: Absolute tax-ledger reconciliation difference must be at most
derivation_rationale: One cent catches ledger drift while allowing deterministic cent rounding.

rule: Simplified immediate realized-tax rate remains
derivation_rationale: This is carried unchanged from Research v1.0 and is not a prospective tuning parameter.

rule: Commission assumption remains
derivation_rationale: The accepted zero-commission convention is preserved for path comparability.

rule: MODEL_SLIPPAGE_BPS: canonical simulated slippage assumption remains
derivation_rationale: The accepted five-basis-point model input is immutable; OBSERVED_SLIPPAGE_PROXY_BPS is a separate market-data diagnostic.

rule: Minimum valid order-level market-data proxies required for nearest-rank p95
derivation_rationale: If fewer than 20 valid positive bid/ask or opening-auction proxies exist, the metric is NOT_OBSERVABLE_IN_PAPER_MODE rather than zero or realized execution slippage.

rule: Unavailable quote/auction evidence is reported as NOT_OBSERVABLE_IN_PAPER_MODE
derivation_rationale: Paper mode has no broker execution; no synthetic price or fabricated zero is permitted.

rule: p95 absolute tracking_difference_bps compares canonical simulated fill with the market-data proxy
derivation_rationale: It is separate from NAV_RECONCILIATION_ERROR_USD and is not combined with slippage proxy values.

rule: Primary return PASS requires a strict one-sided HAC lower bound above zero
derivation_rationale: A positive estimate alone cannot pass; equality at zero is INCONCLUSIVE.

rule: Primary return PASS requires cumulative_excess strictly above zero
derivation_rationale: Cumulative excess equal to zero is not positive evidence.

rule: MECHANISM_INFORMATION_LIMITED is true when n_state_changes equals this value
derivation_rationale: No arbitrary crossing quota is imposed; zero state changes force INCONCLUSIVE after higher-priority checks.

rule: MECHANISM_INFORMATION_LIMITED is true when n_completed_episodes equals this value
derivation_rationale: Zero completed episodes force INCONCLUSIVE after higher-priority checks; adverse observations remain diagnostic only.

rule: ORIGINAL_RESEARCH_OBJECTIVE Goal A is strategy MaxDD >= QQQ MaxDD
derivation_rationale: Historical Goal A remains a separate reported status and is never silently replaced by the paper severe-risk gate.

rule: ORIGINAL_RESEARCH_OBJECTIVE Goal B is MaxDD >= -45%
derivation_rationale: Historical Goal B remains unchanged and is reported separately from the -60% paper governance limit.

rule: ORIGINAL_RESEARCH_OBJECTIVE Goal C is MaxDD >= -50%
derivation_rationale: Historical Goal C remains unchanged and is reported separately from the -60% paper governance limit.

rule: Emit PAPER_PROTOCOL_RESULT separately from ORIGINAL_RESEARCH_GOAL_STATUS
derivation_rationale: PAPER_PROTOCOL_PASS_DOES_NOT_IMPLY_ORIGINAL_GOAL_PASS.
